g11-economics-ue6-t1.overview: Economic Growth and Economic Development sits inside Economic Development. Economic development is the focus of Unit 6 of Grade 11 Economics in the Ethiopian (FDRE Ministry of Education) curriculum. First, it separates economic development from economic growth. Then it looks at the measures of productivity. Next, it introduces the Human Development Index (HDI) and Ethiopia’s rank. Also it presents the capability approach and sustainable development. Finally, it reviews the Millennium and Sustainable Development Goals. Students will also learn how economic development improves real-life well-being.
objectives: Distinguish economic growth from economic development.
Explain the measures of productivity.
Compute and interpret the Human Development Index.
Describe the capability approach and sustainable development.
Assess Ethiopia’s progress on the MDGs and SDGs.
g11-economics-ue6-t1.simple:
Economic Growth and Economic Development in plain words. The exam wants you to recognise the core ideas, not to memorise whole paragraphs. Focus on:
  • First, the difference between economic growth and economic development.
  • Also why development means more than a rise in output.
g11-economics-ue6-t1.detailed:
Economic Growth and Economic Development — the essentials. First, the difference between economic growth and economic development. Also why development means more than a rise in output.

What the MoE expects you to be able to do:

  • Distinguish economic growth from economic development.
  • Explain the measures of productivity.
  • Compute and interpret the Human Development Index.
  • Describe the capability approach and sustainable development.
  • Assess Ethiopia’s progress on the MDGs and SDGs.
